items.title: Kris Dunn became the 9th player in Clippers franchise history to post at least 15 points, 5 assists, 5 steals, and 2 blocks in a game. Last to do it was Kawhi Leonard. The last guard to do it was Eric Bledsoe. Fifth player since 1995 to do it for the team.
